title: Vivo launches T5e budget segment phone with Unisoc chip
summary: Vivo has launched the T5e, a budget 4G smartphone in India running OriginOS 6 on Android 16. The device features a 6.74-inch HD+ 90Hz display, Unisoc T7225 chipset, 4 GB RAM with 4 GB virtual RAM, 64 GB storage expandable up to 2 TB, a 5,500 mAh battery with 15W charging and reverse charging, and basic 8 MP rear and 5 MP front cameras. It is priced at ₹13,999 and available in two colors.
content:
Published: July 27, 2026 01:15 pm IST

Vivo on Monday, July 27, 2026, launched a new budget-segment smartphone in India, the Vivo T5e. The phone ships with OriginOS 6 based on Android 16 out of the box and targets entry-level buyers seeking a large display and long battery life at an affordable price.

Display and Build
The Vivo T5e features a 6.74-inch HD+ display with a 90 Hz refresh rate, delivering smoother animations and scrolling compared with typical 60 Hz budget panels. The device carries an IP64 rating for dust and splash resistance, offering added durability for everyday use.

Performance and Memory
Powering the T5e is the Unisoc T7225 chipset. The phone comes with 4 GB of physical RAM and 64 GB of onboard storage. Vivo also includes 4 GB of virtual RAM to boost multitasking, and the storage is expandable via microSD up to 2 TB, which is uncommon at this price point.

Battery and Charging
The handset is equipped with a large 5,500 mAh battery and ships with a 15W charger in the box. Vivo has also added reverse charging support, enabling the device to act as a power source for small accessories or other phones in a pinch.

Cameras
Photography hardware on the T5e is basic but serviceable for the segment: an 8 MP rear camera and a 5 MP front-facing selfie camera. Vivo positions the phone for users prioritizing battery life and display size over advanced imaging capabilities.

Software and Connectivity
The device runs OriginOS 6 layered on Android 16. It is a 4G smartphone and does not include 5G connectivity, consistent with its budget positioning and the Unisoc processor used.

Price, Colors and Availability
Vivo has priced the T5e at ₹13,999 for the 4 GB + 64 GB variant. It will be available in Shadow Grey and Aero Blue color options. The phone is being sold through Flipkart, Vivo's online store, and offline retail partners across India.

Conclusion
The Vivo T5e aims to attract buyers seeking a large screen, extended battery life and expandable storage at a lower price point. With its Unisoc T7225 chipset, 4 GB RAM plus virtual memory, and a 5,500 mAh battery, the device competes in the crowded budget segment by focusing on endurance and everyday usability rather than high-end performance or advanced cameras.
